answer: Each agent must lock a bond and complete verifiable micro-tasks before gaining voice; peers cross-check results, and rewards accrue like a plume rising only with real effort. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted work attestations. Fake identities gain nothing, since forging consensus would mandate outspending honest stake and watching their bond shatter like a crystal. Sybils may wander in freely, but without costly, proven work they stay voiceless and unranked, making attack costs exceed any payoff. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
